title: Aara
headline: A quieter kind of everyday ritual.
summary: A conceptual identity for an imagined Indian tea label, exploring stillness through refined serif typography, botanical illustration, earthy tones and coordinated packaging.
description: Aara imagines tea as a small everyday ritual. Its visual language balances deep green and warm parchment tones, expressive high-contrast typography and delicate botanical artwork across cartons, a tea tin and printed touchpoints.
